project_name: Chandrayaan-2 & LROC Lunar Image Sub-Pixel Registration System
emotional_tone: Tactical precision, aerospace authority, sub-pixel scientific rigor, calm telemetry focus

typography.h2: text-xl md:text-2xl font-semibold tracking-tight text-slate-100 font-mono

layout_and_grid.mode: MODE B: High Density Mission Control Dashboard

regions.header_telemetry_bar: col-span-full h-16 border-b border-slate-800 bg-slate-950/90 backdrop-blur-md px-6 flex items-center justify-between z-50 sticky top-0
regions.registration_canvas_viewer: lg:col-span-8 bg-slate-900/90 border border-slate-800 rounded-lg p-4 relative min-h-[460px]

regions.lroc_catalog_drawer_panel: col-span-full border border-slate-800 bg-slate-900/60 rounded-lg p-5

key_features_and_workflow: Source-only image upload dropzone with immediate metadata validation (Chandrayaan-2 Optical / OHRC format detection).
Automatic LROC reference selection query running against local catalog database with LROC URL metadata fallback.
Dual-canvas split / interactive overlay viewport with toggleable modes: Split Screen, Alpha Blend Overlay, Difference Map, and Sub-Pixel Vector Residual Vectors.
Real-time Sub-Pixel Alignment controls: Fine-grained X/Y shift, Rotation angle (0.01 deg step), Scale ratio, and RANSAC inlier threshold adjustment.
Deterministic Feature Matching Engine (SIFT/ORB/Affinement simulator with real mathematical RMSE, Inlier Count, Inlier Ratio, and Sub-pixel Offset calculation).
Interactive Match Points Table with coordinate list (Source X/Y vs Reference X/Y, Residual Error px, Status), clickable to highlight point on viewport canvas.
LROC Public Links Catalog Panel connected to local database layer with links to https://lroc.im.-ldi.com/images/downloads/ and https://quickmap.lroc.im-ldi.com/ with graceful offline fallback.

Header.styling: border-b border-slate-800 bg-slate-950/90 text-slate-100 flex items-center justify-between px-6 py-3
elements: Mission status badge: LUNAR REGISTRATION ONLINE
Orbital coordinate system telemetry indicator (Moon ME frame / MOON2000)
Quick action controls: Reset Session, Export GeoTIFF/JSON registration report, Toggle Dark HUD grid lines

SourceUploadPanel.styling: bg-slate-900/80 border border-slate-800 rounded-lg p-5 space-y-4
SourceUploadPanel.rules: Must support single file drag-and-drop or file selector for Chandrayaan-2 optical TIFF/PNG/JPEG. Once uploaded, trigger automatic reference image resolution.

RegistrationViewport.styling: relative bg-black border border-slate-800 rounded-lg overflow-hidden min-h-[480px] flex flex-col
canvas_layers: Base canvas for Source Image rendering
Warped canvas for Reference Image alignment
SVG overlay layer for match point crosshairs (Amber for Source, Cyan for Reference) and green connection vectors
Sub-pixel zoom glass loupe tool on hover

EvaluationMetricsPanel.styling: bg-slate-900/90 border border-slate-800 rounded-lg p-5 space-y-4

MatchPointsTable.features: Searchable, sortable table of coordinate correspondences with data-testid attributes for every row and coordinate cell.

CatalogMetadataDrawer.styling: bg-slate-900/70 border border-slate-800 rounded-lg p-5 space-y-3

testing_requirements.rule: Every button, input, table row, tab, card, and telemetry readout MUST include a explicit data-testid attribute in kebab-case.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build the dashboard UI using React with Tailwind CSS and Lucide icons.
Strictly follow the dark mission-control design with slate-950 background, subtle grid overlays, and restrained lunar amber (#F59E0B) and cyan (#06B6D4) accents.
Ensure source upload triggers immediate automatic reference selection from the catalog with visual feedback.
Implement interactive canvas overlay for match points with toggle modes (Split, Alpha Blend, Difference, Residual Vectors) and sub-pixel alignment sliders (X-shift, Y-shift, Rotation, Scale).
Display detailed metrics card for RMSE, Inlier Count, Inlier Ratio, and Sub-pixel accuracy with clear evaluation labels.
Provide coordinate correspondence table listing source and reference (x, y) coordinates with click-to-highlight functionality.

Include LROC catalog integration panel displaying local catalog metadata and direct links to https://lroc.im.-ldi.com/images/downloads/ and https://quickmap.lroc.im-ldi.com/ with graceful fallback static dataset.
Add data-testid attributes to all interactive components as specified.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Never center-align the main App container globally.
Avoid generic bright SaaS blues or default light backgrounds. Stick strictly to the dark mission control tactical palette.
Ensure all contrast ratios meet WCAG AA / APCA standards against dark slate backgrounds.
Provide smooth hover states and active focus states with distinct amber/cyan glow rings.
Ensure responsive layout scales gracefully from desktop 1080p mission screens down to tablet viewport width.
